meanings.usage: 用于描述北欧地区的国家或文化
形容政策、制度等具有先进性和人性化
强调事物逐渐演变发展的过程
形容滥用权力、傲慢的行为方式
形容在工作或职责上不能胜任的人
表示采取措施保护某人或某物免受伤害
指个人对不公正待遇的申诉或投诉
指负责调查公民对政府官员投诉的官员
形容做事过于热情而可能出错
指权威人士对下属的正式责备
指通过调查或研究来发现事实真相
形容对某事物持有不公平的先入为主的看法
指通过法律程序对某人提起诉讼
形容行动迅速、毫不拖延的
指正式向有关部门提交投诉或申诉

phrases.usage: 为了公共利益；符合公众利益

examples.en: The minister acted in the public interest.
examples.zh: 部长为了公共利益行事。

phrases.usage: 逐步形成一套优秀的体制

examples.en: Sweden has evolved an excellent system for protecting citizens.
examples.zh: 瑞典逐步形成了一套优秀的保护公民的体制。

examples.en: The system protects the individual citizen from incompetent officials.
examples.zh: 该体制保护个人公民免受不称职官员的侵害。

phrases.usage: 保护...的利益；维护...的利益

examples.en: The scheme was introduced to safeguard the interest of the individual.
examples.zh: 该方案的出台是为了保护个人的利益。

examples.en: The Ombudsman is not subject to political pressure.
examples.zh: 巡视官不受政治压力的影响。

phrases.usage: 代表某人采取行动；代理

examples.en: If a citizen's complaint is justified, the Ombudsman will act on his behalf.
examples.zh: 如果公民的投诉是合理的，巡视官将代表他采取行动。

examples.en: If any further complaints are lodged against him, he will be prosecuted.
examples.zh: 如果再有人对他提出投诉，他将受到起诉。

examples.en: The Ombudsman's prompt action put an end to an unpleasant practice.
examples.zh: 巡视官的迅速行动结束了一种不良做法。

examples.en: A policeman had dealt roughly with foreigners on several occasions.
examples.zh: 一名警察多次粗暴对待外国人。

phrases.usage: 公开接受公众检查；可供公众查阅

examples.en: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
examples.zh: 巡视官的工作没有任何秘密，因为他的信函可供公众查阅。

grammar.title: 现在完成时的被动语态 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.definition: 现在完成时被动语态表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响，或动作持续到现在，且主语是动作的承受者。 用于描述某个动作或过程的结果，强调其对现在的影响。文中描述瑞典的体制被其他国家采用这一结果。

examples.en: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
examples.zh: 该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了这一体制。

examples.en: The Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme in 1809.
examples.zh: 瑞典议会在1809年推出了一个方案。

grammar.title: 过去分词作定语 (Past Participle as Attribute)
grammar.structure: 名词 + 过去分词 / 过去分词 + 名词
grammar.definition: 过去分词作定语时，放在被修饰的名词之前或之后，表示被动和完成的意义。 用于简化定语从句，使句子更加简洁。常用于正式书面语中。

examples.en: A parliamentary committee representing all political parties appoints a person.
examples.zh: 一个代表所有政党的议会委员会任命一人。

examples.en: The official title of the person is 'Justiteombudsman'.
examples.zh: 这个人的官方头衔是'司法特派员'。

grammar.title: so...that 结果状语从句
grammar.structure: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句
grammar.definition: so后面接形容词或副词，that引导结果状语从句，表示'如此...以至于...'。 用于表达某种程度导致的结果。在文中说明瑞典体制运行良好以至于被其他国家采纳。

examples.en: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
examples.zh: 该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了。

examples.en: He is so busy that he cannot come.

patterns.pattern: The system has worked so well that...

original.en: The system has worked so well that it has been adopted in other countries too.
original.zh: 该体制运行良好，其他国家也采用了这一体制。

imitations.en: The policy has worked so well that it has become a model for other countries.
imitations.zh: 这项政策运行良好，已成为其他国家的典范。

imitations.en: The new teaching method has worked so well that it has been推广 in all schools.
imitations.zh: 新的教学方法效果良好，已在所有学校推广。

patterns.pattern: As long ago as + 年份, ... + 一般过去时

original.en: As long ago as 1809, the Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme to safeguard the interest of the individual.
original.zh: 早在1809年，瑞典议会就推出了保护个人利益的方案。

imitations.en: As long ago as 1990, China began its reform and opening-up policy.
imitations.zh: 早在1990年，中国就开始了改革开放政策。

imitations.en: As long ago as 1950, scientists discovered this phenomenon.
imitations.zh: 早在1950年，科学家们就发现了这一现象。

original.en: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work, for his correspondence is open to public inspection.
original.zh: 巡视官的工作没有任何秘密，因为他的信函可供公众查阅。

imitations.en: There is nothing secretive about the government's decision.
imitations.zh: 政府的这项决定没有任何秘密。

imitations.en: There is nothing secretive about our company's financial report.
imitations.zh: 我们公司的财务报告没有任何隐瞒。

patterns.pattern: The action he takes varies according to...

original.en: The action he takes varies according to the nature of the complaint.
original.zh: 他采取的行动因投诉的性质而异。

imitations.en: The punishment varies according to the seriousness of the crime.
imitations.zh: 惩罚的轻重取决于犯罪的严重程度。

imitations.en: The salary varies according to qualifications and experience.
imitations.zh: 工资根据资历和经验而有所不同。

lines.en: The Scandinavian countries are much admired all over the world for their enlightened social policies.
lines.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚半岛各国实行开明的社会政策，受到全世界的推崇。

lines.en: Sweden has evolved an excellent system for protecting the individual citizen from highhanded or incompetent public officers. The system has worked so well, that it has been adopted in other countries too.
lines.zh: 在瑞典，已逐渐形成了一种完善的制度以保护每个公民不受专横的和不称职的政府官员的欺压。

lines.en: The Swedes were the first to recognize that public official like civil servants, police officers, health inspectors or tax-collectors can make mistakes or act over- zealously in the belief that they are serving the public.
lines.zh: 由于这种制度行之有效，已被其他国家采纳。

lines.en: As long ago as 1809, the Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme to safeguard the interest of the individual.
lines.zh: 是瑞典人首先认识到政府工作人员如文职人员、警官、卫生稽查员、税务人员等等也会犯错误或者自以为在为公众服务而把事情做过了头。

lines.en: A parliamentary committee representing all political parties appoints a person who is suitably qualified to investigate private grievances against the State.
lines.zh: 早在1809年，瑞典论会就建立一个保护公民利益的制度。

lines.en: The official title of the person is 'Justiteombudsman', but the Swedes commonly refer to him as the 'J.O.
lines.zh: 议会内有一个代表各政党利益的委员会，由它委派一位称职的人选专门调查个人对国家的意见。

lines.en: or 'Ombudsman'.
lines.zh: 此人官衔为“司法特派员”，但瑞典人一般管他叫“J.O.”，即“司法特派员”。

lines.en: The Ombudsman is not subject to political pressure.
lines.zh: 司法特派员不受任何政治压力的制约。

lines.en: He investigates complaints large and small that come to him from all levels of society.
lines.zh: 他听取社会各阶层的各种大小意见，并进行调查。

lines.en: As complaints must be made in writing, the Ombudsman receives an average of 1,200 letters a year.
lines.zh: 由于意见均需用书面形式提出，司法特派员每年平均收到1,200封信。

lines.en: He has eight lawyer assistants to help him and examines every single letter in detail.
lines.zh: 他有8位律师作他的助手协助工作，每封信都详细批阅。

lines.en: There is nothing secretive about the Ombudsman's work for his correspondence is open to public inspection .
lines.zh: 司法特派员的工作没有什么秘密可言，他的信件是公开的，供公众监督。

lines.en: If a citizen's complaint is justified , the Ombudsman will act on his behalf.
lines.zh: 如果公民的意见正确，司法特派员便为他伸张正义。

lines.en: The action he takes varies according to the nature of the complaint.
lines.zh: 司法特员采取的行动因意见的性质不同而有所不同。

lines.en: He may gently reprimand an official or even suggest to parliament that a law the altered.
lines.zh: 他可以善意地批评某位官员，也可以甚至向议会提议修改某项法律。

lines.en: The following case is a typical example of the Ombudsman's work.
lines.zh: 下述事件是司法特派员工作的一个典型例子。

lines.en: A foreigner living in a Swedish village wrote to the Ombudsman complaining that he had been ill-treated by the police, simply because he was a foreigner.
lines.zh: 一个住在瑞典乡村的外国人写信给司法特派员，抱怨说他受到警察的虐待，原因就是因为他是个外国人。

lines.en: The Ombudsman immediately wrote to the Chief of Police in the district asking him to send a record of the case.
lines.zh: 司法特派员立即写信给当地警察局长，请他寄送与此事有关的材料。

lines.en: There was nothing in the record to show that the foreigner's complaint was justified and the Chief of Police strongly denied the accusation .
lines.zh: 材料中没有任何文字记载证明外国人所说的情况符合事实，警察局长矢口否认这一指控。

lines.en: It was impossible for the Ombudsman to take action, but when he received a similar complaint from another foreigner in the same village, he immediately sent one of his layers to investigate the matter.
lines.zh: 司法特派员难以处理。

lines.en: The lawyer ascertained that a policeman had indeed dealt roughly with foreigners on several occasions.
lines.zh: 但是，当他又收到住在同一村庄的另一个外国人写的一封内容类似的投诉信时，他立即派出一位律师前去调查。

lines.en: The fact that the policeman was prejudiced against foreigners could not be recorded in the official files.
lines.zh: 律师证实有个警察确实多次粗鲁地对待外国人。

lines.en: It was only possible for the Ombudsman to find this out by sending one of his representatives to check the facts.
lines.zh: 警察歧视外国人的事在官方档案中不可能加以记载，司法特派员只有派他的代表去核对事实才能了解真相。

lines.en: The policeman in question was severely reprimanded and was informed that if any further complaints were lodged against him, he would prosecuted .
lines.zh: 当事的警察受到严厉的斥责，并被告知，如果再有人投诉他，他将受到起诉。

lines.en: The Ombudsman's prompt action at once put an end to an unpleasant practice which might have gone unnoticed.
lines.zh: 司法特派员及时采取的行动，迅速制止了这一起不愉快的事件，不然这件事可能因未得到人们注意而不了了之。

questions.q: What could not be reported in the official files?
questions.zh: 什么内容无法被记录在官方档案里？
questions.a: The fact that the policeman was prejudiced against foreigners.
questions.aZh: 警察歧视外国人的这一事实。
questions.hint: 见课文末段：The fact that the policeman was prejudiced against foreigners could not be recorded in the official files.

questions.q: What kind of system did Sweden evolve, and why was it adopted by other countries?
questions.zh: 瑞典逐渐形成了什么样的制度？为什么被其他国家采纳？
questions.a: A system for protecting the individual citizen from highhanded or incompetent public officers; it worked so well that other countries adopted it.
questions.aZh: 一种保护公民不受专横、不称职官员欺压的制度；因行之有效而被其他国家采纳。

questions.q: What are the requirements for making a complaint, and how many letters does the Ombudsman receive on average each year?
questions.zh: 提出投诉有什么要求？司法特派员每年平均收到多少封信？
questions.a: Complaints must be made in writing; the Ombudsman receives an average of 1,200 letters a year.
questions.aZh: 投诉必须以书面形式提出；他每年平均收到1200封信。

questions.q: How did the Ombudsman deal with the two complaints from the foreigners in the same village?
questions.zh: 司法特派员如何应对同一村庄两位外国人的投诉？
questions.a: The first complaint could not be acted on because nothing in the record proved it; after a similar second complaint he immediately sent one of his lawyers to investigate, and the lawyer ascertained that a policeman had indeed dealt roughly with foreigners.
questions.aZh: 第一封投诉因档案中无证据而无法处理；收到内容类似的第二封投诉后，他立即派律师调查，证实一名警察确实多次粗鲁对待外国人。
questions.hint: 见课文后半部分关于典型案件的叙述。

questions.q: Why is it important that the Ombudsman's correspondence is open to public inspection, and what does this suggest about good government?
questions.zh: 司法特派员的信件公开供公众监督为什么重要？这对良好的治理有何启示？
questions.a: Because openness removes any secrecy and lets the public trust that complaints are handled fairly; it suggests good government must be transparent and accountable rather than subject to political pressure.
questions.aZh: 因为公开能消除隐秘，让公众相信投诉得到公正处理；这说明良好的治理必须透明、负责，而不应受政治压力左右。
questions.hint: 结合“There is nothing secretive…”及“not subject to political pressure”两句谈看法。

translation:
斯堪的纳维亚半岛各国实行开明的社会政策，受到全世界的推崇。
在瑞典，已逐渐形成了一种完善的制度以保护每个公民不受专横的和不称职的政府官员的欺压。
由于这种制度行之有效，已被其他国家采纳。
是瑞典人首先认识到政府工作人员如文职人员、警官、卫生稽查员、税务人员等等也会犯错误或者自以为在为公众服务而把事情做过了头。
早在1809年，瑞典论会就建立一个保护公民利益的制度。
议会内有一个代表各政党利益的委员会，由它委派一位称职的人选专门调查个人对国家的意见。
此人官衔为“司法特派员”，但瑞典人一般管他叫“J.O.”，即“司法特派员”。
司法特派员不受任何政治压力的制约。
他听取社会各阶层的各种大小意见，并进行调查。
由于意见均需用书面形式提出，司法特派员每年平均收到1,200封信。
他有8位律师作他的助手协助工作，每封信都详细批阅。
司法特派员的工作没有什么秘密可言，他的信件是公开的，供公众监督。
如果公民的意见正确，司法特派员便为他伸张正义。
司法特员采取的行动因意见的性质不同而有所不同。
他可以善意地批评某位官员，也可以甚至向议会提议修改某项法律。
下述事件是司法特派员工作的一个典型例子。
一个住在瑞典乡村的外国人写信给司法特派员，抱怨说他受到警察的虐待，原因就是因为他是个外国人。
司法特派员立即写信给当地警察局长，请他寄送与此事有关的材料。
材料中没有任何文字记载证明外国人所说的情况符合事实，警察局长矢口否认这一指控。
司法特派员难以处理。
但是，当他又收到住在同一村庄的另一个外国人写的一封内容类似的投诉信时，他立即派出一位律师前去调查。
律师证实有个警察确实多次粗鲁地对待外国人。
警察歧视外国人的事在官方档案中不可能加以记载，司法特派员只有派他的代表去核对事实才能了解真相。
当事的警察受到严厉的斥责，并被告知，如果再有人投诉他，他将受到起诉。
司法特派员及时采取的行动，迅速制止了这一起不愉快的事件，不然这件事可能因未得到人们注意而不了了之。
title: In the Public Interest
subtitle: 为了公众利益

lead.question: 瑞典的司法特派员制度，如何保护公民权益、约束官员并杜绝不良作风？
lead.warmup: 斯堪的纳维亚国家以开明的社会政策闻名于世。早在1809年，瑞典议会就设立司法特派员（Ombudsman），专门受理公民对政府机关的投诉。他不受政治压力左右，每年审阅约1200封书面投诉信，并有八位律师协助。课文通过一个外国人遭警察粗暴对待的真实案例，展示这位“公众利益守护者”如何查明真相、伸张正义。
goals: 掌握 public interest、authority、investigate、complaint 等核心词汇的含义与用法。
理解并运用被动语态（complaints must be made、was informed、would be prosecuted 等）。
熟悉定语从句、宾语从句及形容词后置作定语（complaints large and small）等结构。
了解瑞典司法特派员制度，学习用英语叙述一个典型案例的来龙去脉。
lead.summary: 本文介绍瑞典独创的司法特派员制度。议会委员会委派一位称职者，专门调查公民对国家机关的投诉；他独立于政治压力，每年处理约1200封书面来信，信件公开受公众监督。若投诉属实，他可为公民伸张正义，轻则斥责官员，重则建议议会修改法律。课文以外侨遭警察粗暴对待的案例，说明这一制度如何及时制止可能被忽视的弊端。
lead.tips: 注意 complaints large and small 中两个相反形容词须后置作定语；suggest to parliament that a law be altered 用虚拟语气，动词用原形 be；subject to、in the belief that 等固定搭配要整体记忆。

exercises.q: 汉译英：司法特派员的工作是为了公众利益。
exercises.a: The work of the Ombudsman is in the public interest.
exercises.note: 固定短语：为了公众利益

exercises.q: 汉译英：他派一位律师去调查此事。
exercises.a: He sent a lawyer to investigate the matter.

exercises.q: 填空：He investigates ______ ______ ______ that come to him from all levels of society.（大大小小的）
exercises.note: 相反形容词后置作定语

exercises.q: 句型转换（改为被动语态）：The Ombudsman examines every single letter in detail.
exercises.a: Every single letter is examined in detail by the Ombudsman.

exercises.q: 改错：He may suggest to parliament that a law is altered.
exercises.a: He may suggest to parliament that a law be altered.
exercises.note: suggest 后从句用虚拟语气

exercises.q: 填空：A parliamentary committee appoints a person ______ is suitably qualified to investigate private grievances against the State.
汉译英：公民可以就政府当局的专横行为提出投诉。
exercises.a: Citizens may complain against the highhanded conduct of the authorities.

quiz.q: 司法特派员专门调查的是什么？
options: private grievances against the State
the public policies of Parliament
the tax records of citizens
disputes between two villages
quiz.note: investigate private grievances against the State

quiz.q: 关于投诉的形式，课文怎么说？
options: They must be made in writing.
They must be made by telephone.
They must be signed by a lawyer.
They must be sent to the newspapers.
quiz.note: As complaints must be made in writing

quiz.q: 司法特派员的工作有什么特点？
options: Nothing is secretive; his correspondence is open to public inspection.
He keeps all letters strictly secret.
He works under heavy political pressure.
He never examines letters in detail.
quiz.note: 对应 open to public inspection

quiz.q: 对于经证实的投诉，司法特派员可能采取的行动是？
options: He may gently reprimand an official or suggest altering a law.
He may arrest the official at once.
He may dismiss the whole parliament.
He may pay the citizen a large sum of money.
quiz.note: gently reprimand…or suggest a law be altered

quiz.q: 外侨的投诉案件最终结果如何？
options: The policeman in question was severely reprimanded.
The policeman was promoted for his work.
The foreigner was asked to leave Sweden.
The Chief of Police was prosecuted.
quiz.note: 当事警察受到严厉斥责

quiz.q: 瑞典这套制度为什么重要？
options: It put an end to an unpleasant practice which might have gone unnoticed.
It increased the number of civil servants.
It raised taxes for the poor.
It replaced the Swedish Parliament.
